findings.message: references 6 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Use persist-credentials: false when checking out external/untrusted repositories.
findings.impact: An untrusted checkout can read a persisted GITHUB_TOKEN from Git configuration and reuse its repository privileges.
findings.attack_vector: actions/checkout selects an external or event-controlled revision while persist-credentials remains enabled.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: writes to system directories or boot locations
findings.remediation: Restrict file writes to user-owned directories with explicit approval.
findings.impact: System startup and installation directories are sensitive destinations for persistent modification.
findings.attack_vector: Source references a boot or system directory; this low lead does not by itself prove mutation or privilege.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes request-controlled input directly to an operating-system command API
findings.remediation: Use a fixed executable and an allowlisted argv array; never pass request values to a shell command.
findings.impact: Request-controlled command input can execute arbitrary operating-system commands with plugin privileges.
findings.attack_vector: A request body, query, parameter, header, argv, or input value reaches exec/spawn/os.system within the same call-site window.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: passes an unvalidated dynamic destination to a network API
findings.remediation: Parse the destination, require HTTPS, and allowlist hosts and resolved IP ranges before making the request.
findings.impact: An attacker-controlled URL can make the plugin request internal services, cloud metadata, or attacker-selected hosts.
findings.attack_vector: A non-literal destination derived from request input reaches a network API without an evident allowlist guard.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: invokes an operating-system process API (5 calls in this file)
